title: Love these!
text: Love these!. I wasn't sure about how big these would be exactly so I will tell you here as a piece comparison ,they are about half the size of a regular tan clothes pin. I got the red because I want to hang up a string with these clothes pins to hang my Christmas cards on and they are perfect for that !  They close nicely and stay closed. They are very easy to open in handle Great for any crafter or even as a gift for 1.
